relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast to a single cytokine blockade by bDMARDs, JAK inhibitors inhibit the effect of multiple cytokines

key_findings: Meta-analysis of 50 RCTs (24,135 RA patients): JAK inhibitors outperformed placebo, methotrexate and bDMARDs on pain and disease activity outcomes.
No significant difference in serious adverse events versus comparators.
